meta.title: NASA reference data pack — Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer
meta.challenge: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 — Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer
meta.intended_use: Reference values for game/databases/sources and for the in-game Data Sources panel. Values are archived snapshots, not live feeds.
meta.license_note: NASA data is generally public domain (U.S. Government work). Verify each source page and credit the instrument/mission.

shielding.4_g_cm2_regolith: SPE dose reduced below current 30-day limits (Matthia 2024)

sources.name: LRO CRaTER via NASA RadLab
sources.note: January 2010 mean 13.099 uGy/h = 0.314 mGy/day (absorbed dose in silicon/water conversion as served by RadLab).

sources.name: Chang'E-4 LND lunar surface dosimetry
sources.note: 13.2 +/- 1 uGy/h total absorbed dose; 1369 uSv/day dose equivalent on the lunar surface.

sources.name: Matthia et al. 2024, Radiation Exposure and Shielding Effects on the Lunar Surface
sources.note: 0.84 mSv/day unshielded; 0.6 mSv/day at ~20 g/cm2; >4 g/cm2 regolith keeps SPE below 30-day limits.

sources.name: NASA-STD-3001 Vol. 1 Rev. B, section 4.8
sources.note: 600 mSv career limit (all ages/sexes); 250 mSv design reference SPE limit.

sources.name: ISS DosTel via NASA RadLab
sources.note: 1 June 2024 mean 4.65 uGy/h = 0.112 mGy/day inside ISS.

sources.name: Artemis I HERA via NASA RadLab
sources.note: 16 Nov-11 Dec 2022: mean 19.5 uGy/h; total ~11.9 mGy over the mission.

environment.dust: abrasive, electrostatically charged, no wind; EDS removed 82% from thermal radiator and 97% from glass in the 2025 lunar demo

space_weather_events.label: G5 geomagnetic storm, May 2024
space_weather_events.game_use: Worst-case storm card; 1-2 day CME lead time; shelter decision.

space_weather_events.label: O-type CME, 17 October 2026
space_weather_events.game_use: Quiet-week card: a fast CME can miss; not every event is a crisis.

space_weather_events.label: NASA design reference solar particle event (October 1989)
space_weather_events.game_use: Storm magnitude calibrates the 250 mSv mission budget.

osdr_studies.title: 37-Day microgravity exposure in 16-Week female C57BL/6J mice during NASA Rodent Research 1 is associated with bone loss specific to weight-bearing skeletal sites
osdr_studies.finding: Bone loss at weight-bearing sites (femur and vertebrae) after 37 days.
osdr_studies.game_use: Science Log: long missions cost bone; exercise and nutrition matter.

osdr_studies.title: Spaceflight-Induced Bone Loss Alters Failure Mode and Reduces Bending Strength in Murine Spinal Segments from Bion-M1
osdr_studies.finding: 30-day Bion-M1 flight reduced vertebral bone volume fraction, bone mineral density and bending strength.
osdr_studies.game_use: Science Log: bone loss is not just a number; it changes structural strength.

osdr_studies.title: Effects of 21 days of bedrest on human skeletal muscle gene expression
osdr_studies.finding: 21 days of bed rest changes human muscle gene expression.
osdr_studies.game_use: Science Log: unloading costs muscle; daily exercise is a countermeasure.

osdr_studies.title: Exercise Training Attenuates the Muscle Mitochondria Genomic Response to Bed Rest
osdr_studies.finding: Exercise blunts the mitochondrial response to bed rest.
osdr_studies.game_use: Science Log: exercise is a real countermeasure, not flavor.

osdr_studies.title: Spaceflight Modulates Gene Expression in Astronauts
osdr_studies.finding: Spaceflight changes gene expression in astronauts.
osdr_studies.game_use: Science Log: the body adapts to space in measurable ways.

osdr_studies.title: SpaceX Inspiration4 Urine Inflammation Panel (Multiplex, NULISAseq)
osdr_studies.finding: Inflammation markers measured in Inspiration4 crew urine.
osdr_studies.game_use: Science Log: immune/inflammation monitoring is part of crew health.
